exposure: direction of AUE (inferior, lateral and superior)
accidental uterine extension (AUE) during cesarean delivery
cohort: Women with a prior cesarean delivery with AUE at a tertiary medical center between January 2011 and January 2022.
finding: Subsequent pregnancies after AUE are not associated with higher maternal or neonatal adverse outcomes including higher proportions of uterine rupture compared to pregnancies without previous AUE.
